enabled.description: Master switch. When false the plugin loads but never intercepts dispatch. Default: true.

channels.description: List of channel IDs to gate. Messages from other channels are passed through unchanged. Default: ['openclaw-weixin'].

triggerKeywords.description: Substrings that, when present in inbound text, cause dispatch to proceed. Default: core Chinese query verbs.

suppressMediaOnly.description: Whether inbound messages with empty text (bare media like images/files) are silently absorbed. Default: true.

mediaAckText.description: If set, the first media-only message in a burst gets this text replied once. Leave blank for full silence. Default: empty.
